problem_restatement.input: The live v53 HYPE route has no fixed target, and prior descriptions asserted that an opposite signal can close the position.
problem_restatement.required_output: Prove the exact exit path in the deployed v53 identity and distinguish an eligible opposite strategy intent from a raw indicator change.
constraints: Do not mutate the active v53 process or configuration.
Do not infer exit profitability from unit tests or a zero-trade v53 run.
Preserve the rejected fixed-target hypothesis unless new evidence satisfies its reopen condition.
success_criteria: The exact v53 provider is executable on both HYPE sides.
Its position policy maps an eligible opposite intent to a close action.
The close occurs without a same-cycle reversal.
Stop and maximum-hold fallbacks remain explicit.

fixed_take_profit.reason: The preregistered symmetric 40-500 bps target study did not beat the native exit and materially degraded total net return.

exit_contract.provider_recipe_scope_note: This setting ignores provider-native exit_sides telemetry. It does not disable the portfolio router's executable opposite-entry-intent close path.

covered_paths: exact v52-to-v53 route and exit-contract inheritance
exact v53 identity and freshness-only delta
HYPE replay parity for next-open opposite-intent exit

limitations: The fixed-target evidence is development-selected and has only one later confirmation lifecycle.
One-minute OHLC cannot prove private IOC fills or intrabar target-versus-stop ordering.
v53 itself has not produced an eligible event or resolved lifecycle.

assessment.finding: The v53 HYPE opposite-intent exit is wired end-to-end for a fresh eligible aligned opposite onset. No technical exit-routing defect was reproduced.
failure_modes: A profitable position can give back gains before another fully eligible aligned onset appears.
A stop gap can exceed the nominal 80 bps distance.
Freshness or telemetry failure can prevent soft-hold extension and force the fallback exit.
The route may have negative expectancy despite correct execution.
assessment.falsifier: A source-bound v53 lifecycle in which an admitted opposite aligned intent does not create one close action, creates a same-cycle reversal, or closes under a different unreported rule would invalidate this audit.

recommendation.Recommendation: Leave the v53 HYPE exit contract unchanged and audit its first resolved lifecycle immediately.
recommendation.Why now: The technical contract is coherent, while no v53 lifecycle exists to justify a new exit modification.
recommendation.Evidence reviewed: Exact v53 config, HYPE alignment collector, bidirectional router, route cycle, execution serializer, live-runner tests, HYPE exit replay, and fixed-target rejection journal.
recommendation.Observed problem or opportunity: The important remaining uncertainty is economic performance, not missing opposite-intent wiring.
recommendation.Applicable market regime: Compression-breakout onsets whose breakout direction and intended position side agree.
recommendation.Alternatives considered: Add a fixed target, add a trailing profit lock, honor raw provider exits, close on any opposite indicator, or preserve the source-compatible native contract.
recommendation.Expected upside: Avoids post-hoc exit churn while retaining stop, aligned-opposite, and bounded-hold protection.
recommendation.Main risks and failure modes: Profit giveback before a qualifying opposite onset, stop gaps, sparse entries, and unproven expectancy.
recommendation.Validation completed: Exact disk-config probe and 64 focused route/provider/runner/replay tests.
recommendation.Validation still required: One fully reconciled v53 lifecycle per side, exact costs and latency, MFE/MAE, exit attribution, and missed-opportunity review.
recommendation.Success metrics: Every fill is protected; every admitted opposite intent closes once without reversal; soft/hard holds use fresh evidence; after-cost side-level outcomes remain positive beyond the largest winner.
recommendation.Failure / rollback triggers: Missing protection, ignored admitted opposite intent, duplicate reversal, stale hold evidence, unexplained exit, or a predeclared compatible loss pattern triggers immediate review.
recommendation.Confidence level: high on technical wiring; low on v53 profitability
